controls.positive_oracle_wiring: In every seed, the oracle router has expected success >= every other routing arm.
controls.negative_flat_world: In a flat world where all experts have identical success probability 0.55, cold Thompson regret is 0.0 and mean success lies inside uniform's 95% CI.
controls.negative_corrupted_both_scouts_fails: Planting corruption in BOTH scouts of a 2-scout cell allows sybils through (control shows the check can fail when the 1-of-2 assumption is violated).

H_S14_01.rule: exoplanet and stars both beat their matched controls at p_worst < 0.05 and gain over base; cyber and maths remain NO_GAIN

H_S14_08.rule: stars passes own-pack (require_improvement=True) and pooled transfer/interference non-regression gate

H_S15_01.rule: Under use_trial_budget=True, per-signer budget (max_trials_per_signer=20) strictly lowers early regret and expected-success gap vs truly uncapped trial volume (max_trials_per_signer=None) when sybils claim n=500

H_S15_02.rule: With 2 independent scouts per cell and 1 scout corrupted to 1.0, dual_scout_bounds preserves >= 80% of the H4 early-regret reduction relative to no scout check

H_S15_04.rule: TaskDecompositionRouter routing verified subtasks independently beats whole-task single-expert planner-as-router baseline in >= 18 of 20 seeds

H_S15_05.rule: VerifiedIDECorrectionFlow enforces <= 30% unverified mix, lowers DPO loss on verified pairs, accepts non-regressing candidate, and rejects regressing candidate

H_S15_06.rule: Exact product-space LoRA aggregation achieves < 1e-5 Frobenius error to mean(B_i @ A_i) while naive factor averaging has error > 0.05, Multi-Krum rejects the Byzantine worker, and PrivacyAccountant blocks step exceeding max_epsilon
